headline: Enes Kulak surges to the edge of ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Enes Kulak gained 14.30 points to reach 44.86, leaping from 850th to 20th on the public board.
Gold currently covers the top 15 places, leaving Kulak just outside the medal group as the chase tightens.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
